reason: Students already get every notice on WhatsApp groups and our ERP vendor handles the rest; if we need an alerts feed I'd ask them to add it rather than pay a small startup ₹9 lakh a year for another app.
objection: This duplicates what WhatsApp and our ERP already do, and I can't justify a new recurring line item plus an IT access approval for an unknown startup when our vendor will probably ship something similar.
would_change_my_mind: A pilot report from a college like ours showing a clear, measurable drop in missed exams and submissions that WhatsApp groups and the ERP portal didn't achieve, priced low enough to sign off without a committee.
